Client::ReportExecutionState
shall treat it as a Violation when invoked by a
Non-reporting Process
.
⌋
(RS_EM_00103)
7.4.2 Process States
Process States
characterize the lifecycle of a
process
from the point of view of
Execution Management
. In other words,
Process States
represent the
Exe-
cution Management
internal tracking of the
Execution States
(see Section 7.4.1)
and hence there is no need for a standardized type. Note that each
process
is in-
dependent and therefore has its own
Process State
.
Process State
is used by
Execution Management
to resolve Execution Dependencies, manage timeouts, etc.
Additionally to the existing values for the
Process State
(
Idle
,
Starting
,
Run-
ning
,
Terminating
,
Terminated
), the implementation may define its own
Process
States
, which are not in conflict/not replacing the existing ones.
